integrity: The recent primary source was checked through its definition, generating function, derivative identity, eventual real-rootedness theorem, and arcsine zero-density conclusion. The subcritical argument independently uses the standard uniform Gegenbauer interior asymptotic from DLMF, Dirichlet summation, positivity for x>1, and Rolle counting. No numerical experiment is used in the proof.
scientific_limitations: For 0<alpha<1 the result proves only that the real-zero proportion tends to zero. It does not determine a finite-n formula, a quantitative o(n) rate, or the limiting measure of the nonreal zeros.
title: Sharp real-zero phase transition for Gegenbauer partial sums
